# Counteroffer

> Counteroffer is a custom-built, white-label, all-in-one CRM for small businesses, built by The Chief Negotiators (Chief Negotiators LLC, St. Petersburg, Florida). Each client's CRM is branded with their own company name, logo and colours.

Included in one license: contacts and accounts, sales pipeline, automatic email/call/meeting logging, two-way Outlook and Microsoft Calendar sync, email marketing and drip sequences, quotes and RFQs, DocuSign e-signature, letters of intent, invoices and purchase orders, finance (cash, margin, A/R, A/P), referral tracking, event invitations and RSVP pages, automated prospecting agents, multi-brand reporting and a brand studio.

Pricing: custom build plus annual license, starting at $20,000 per year, optional support. Suited to agencies, consultants, real estate, professional services and sales teams of 2–20 reps. Positioned as a Salesforce and HubSpot alternative for small business.
